scope: Fixed source-advanced ocean pilot; no local refinement or automatic adoption

plan.purpose: Test a physical ocean-water boundary law after finite joint calibration failed to beat the retained wind setting. Separate the absolute hydrostatic uniform target from a half-strength pressure RH taper; both hold the existing declared surface RH. No observed humidity or temperature enters model forcing.
plan.physical_definition: Only the eight declared shared axes may differ from the fresh environmental control; literal grid further fixes all but wind and the new ocean modes at the retained rain setting. Four core source replacements are explicitly committed; every other source/input is unchanged. Actual interior water stays independently solved; all planetary properties and numerical/skill requirements are fixed.
plan.control: Four exact controls precede six fixed candidate settings. The fresh legacy4.5 candidate must additionally reproduce the retained old wind setting, including every main NPZ field and native companion.
plan.screen: Newpolicy: assess hard physical/structural eligibility separately from observational skill. Noindividualregion, nativehumidity orSST prediction-errorveto duringoptimization. Penalize average andregional/native/oceanregret explicitly; report every raw error and original strict-gate violation ascontext in publication. Missing/nonfinite scores, unpairedcases/footprints and changedfixedparameters failclosed. No alteration ofoldcampaignresults.
plan.advance: Same research shortlist and separately frozen broader Earth/ocean/resolution/world requirements; no local proposals or automatic adoption.
plan.publication: Every fixed six-dimensional point, failure, source/input identity and prediction tradeoff. New finite coverage is not a global-optimum certificate.

design.local_rule: Fixed paired grid only; best-start bookkeeping, no local proposals.

objective.definition: Equal-region mean0.5*(TMAE/Tref+rainloss/rainref), plus0.25mean(max(regional_combined-1.05,0)^2), plus0.05mean(max(native_normalized_regression,0)^2), plus0.05mean(max(ocean_normalized_regression,0)^2). Native wind,PW,qshape errors versus fixed transportcontrol(NI,Iberia,EA) or correctedoriginalwindcontrol(PNW), denominatorsmax(baseline,.5m/s,1mm,.02qratio) respectively. Ocean error versusr39/max(baseline,.1C). Denominator floors are predeclared normalization scales, NOT measured reference uncertainty. No skill error vetoes physical eligibility.

validation_shortlist.scope: At mosttwo candidates may advance to separately frozen broader validation; these are research screening thresholds, not adoption. Fifteenpercent regional combined cap permits bounded tradeoffs, unlike earlier2percentveto. Do not change after outcomes. All scores/failures remain visible.

plan.source_policy: Commitplan/script/tests before any new Earth integration. Freeze allparent protocol scientificsources plusnewsource/plan/controlrows/arrays, recheck everyprofile andcompletion. Preserve failures. No simultaneous edits to frozen sources. Eachactualintegrationincludingcontrols counts; cached local proposals do not.
plan.publication_design_text: Two fixed background winds (4.5 and 3.5 m/s) each receive legacy, absolute hydrostatic uniform-RH, and half-taper RH ocean targets. Surface RH retains its calibrated value; total water is not renormalized. Actual sea temperatures drive the profiles and interior humidity remains independently solved. Four exact controls and a matched legacy epoch control protect existing behavior. No local proposals follow.

ocean_profile_pilot.scope: Legacy versus absolute hydrostatic uniform/half RH targets, at two fixed winds. Reference support is not a coupled climate gain.
